atoms.b: Rural areas take up a large majority of the ((Spain’s ++United_Kingdom’s)) land.

instruction.text: What percentage of the UK’s land do you think is used for agriculture?

feedback.finish: Forestry, which is another use of rural land, makes up a further 20% of the land in the UK.

instruction.text: Different areas in the UK focus on different types of agriculture. Select all correct areas on the map to find out more.

hint.text: You may have to select more than one area.

feedback.end: Arable farming is most common in the eastern regions of the UK, as the land is quite flat and the soil is most fertile here.
Cattle farming is most common in Northern Ireland and the western regions of England, as the wetter climate allows for lush, green hills that are perfect for cows to graze on.
Hill farming is most common in north-western regions of the UK, as well as Wales. The cool summers and steep land are an ideal location for sheep.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The UK also has urban areas, although they only cover 9% of the land. These cities and their surrounding areas are home to most of the UK’s population.

London is the UK’s largest city and its capital. The city has a major impact on the UK’s economy as a lot of the land is used for businesses. There are also many residential areas of London, especially in the suburbs.
London has thousands of recreational spaces, such as Wembley Stadium, which is mostly used to host football events. A lot of these recreational spaces also attract many tourists.

atoms.a: What percentage of the UK’s land is home to urban areas?
Which city is the capital of the UK?
Which type of urban land use attracts tourists?
London has transport connections to many destinations in the UK and all over the world.

feedback.end: There are multiple train stations and airports in London that connect the city to hundreds of other cities.

instruction.text: Draw three lines to connect London to the other European cities to learn more about the transport connections.

feedback.end: The Eurostar is a high-speed train that runs under the English Channel, connecting London with major cities in France, Belgium and the Netherlands. This service makes travel from the UK to Europe much easier.
